lunacy.message.full_moon: The full moon rises. Something stirs in the dark.
lunacy.message.new_moon: The sky goes dark. Stars begin to fall.
config.lunacy.title: Lunacy
config.lunacy.option.fullMoonEvents.tool: More monsters spawn on full moon nights.
config.lunacy.option.fullMoonMonsterCapM: How much the monster cap is raised on full moon nights.
config.lunacy.option.fullMoonSkyOnly.too: Extra monsters only spawn where the sky is visible. Caves and roofed areas stay vanilla.
config.lunacy.option.fullMoonMessage.too: Show a message on the action bar when a full moon rises.
config.lunacy.option.newMoonEvents.toolt: Shooting stars fall on new moon nights.
config.lunacy.option.newMoonMessage.tool: Show a message on the action bar when a new moon night starts.
config.lunacy.option.starsPerNight.toolt: Average shooting stars per player per new moon night. Players close together share stars.
config.lunacy.option.starMinDistance.too: Closest a star lands to a player, in blocks.
config.lunacy.option.starMaxDistance.too: Farthest a star lands from a player, in blocks.
config.lunacy.option.starDropsFadeAtDawn: Star drops still on the ground vanish at sunrise.
config.lunacy.option.echoShardXp.tooltip: Experience points from using an echo shard. 0 turns this off.
